Long, wavy ink-black hair that reaches the waist with a sleek, glossy texture. Sharp, almond-shaped amethyst-purple eyes with a cold, piercing gaze. Apparent age in the early twenties with a mature, sophisticated appearance. Slender, elegant build. A dark, modified navy-blue dress with translucent black lace and deep purple accents. Signature features include a small black bow in the hair and a dark, menacing mechanical rigging.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
